title: Safety
summary: SA'FETY, noun 1. Freedom from danger or hazard; as the safety of an electrical experiment; the safety of a voyage. I was not in safety nor had I rest. Job 3:26. 2. Exemption from hurt, injury or loss.

inlines.v: SA'FETY, noun 1. Freedom from danger or hazard; as the safety of an electrical experiment; the safety of a voyage. I was not in safety nor had I rest. Job 3:26. 2. Exemption from hurt, injury or loss. We crossed the Atlantic in safety
